description: This file defines a NotificationManager class responsible for creating, displaying, and managing various notifications within an Android application, specifically for repository updates, app installations, and app updates in the F-Droid client.

classes.name: NotificationManager
classes.description: A singleton class managing various notifications related to repository updates, app installations, and updates in the F-Droid client.

methods.name: showUpdateRepoNotification
methods.description: Displays a notification about repository updates, with optional throttling and progress indication.

methods.name: getRepoUpdateNotification
methods.description: Constructs a notification builder for repository update notifications.

methods.name: showAppUpdatesAvailableNotification
methods.description: Displays a notification indicating that app updates are available.

methods.name: getAppUpdatesAvailableNotification
methods.description: Constructs a notification builder for app updates available.

methods.name: cancelAppUpdatesAvailableNotification
methods.description: Cancels the app updates available notification.

methods.name: showAppInstallNotification
methods.description: Displays a notification for app installation progress.

methods.name: getAppInstallNotification
methods.description: Constructs a notification builder for app installation.

methods.name: showInstallSuccessNotification
methods.description: Displays a notification indicating successful app installation.

methods.name: getInstallSuccessNotification
methods.description: Constructs a notification builder for successful app installation.

methods.name: getMainActivityPendingIntent
methods.description: Creates a PendingIntent to launch the main activity.

methods.name: getMyAppsPendingIntent
methods.description: Creates a PendingIntent for the 'My Apps' action.

methods.name: s
methods.description: Helper method to get string resources by ID.
